title: CELINE Owner Registry
description:
Schema for owners.yaml and owners.local.yaml — the CELINE-side owner registry. It resolves the ownership blocks in governance.yaml to canonical foaf:Agent metadata (dataset-api), to Keycloak organizations (celine-policies), and to Superset groups and roles (celine-superset).

Scope note: this describes the CELINE registry, not the dataspace identity registry. The `ds` identity-registry models a strictly larger entity — Gaia-X LegalParticipant identity (registration_number, registration_type, hq_country_code, legal_country_code, parent_organizations, sub_organizations) and a verification lifecycle (status, verified_by, evidence_ref) held together by a database CHECK constraint. Its seed files therefore do not validate against this schema, and that is correct rather than drift: the two describe different things that happen to share a file shape. Do not paste those fields in here to make a seed validate — validate IR seeds against the IR's own models. The shared core is what appears below, and celine.governance.OwnerEntry parses both (unknown keys are ignored, so an IR record loads fine for URI resolution).

owners.description: List of owner entries. The id field is the lookup key matched against the name field in governance.yaml ownership blocks.

id.description: Short alias used as the lookup key. Must match the name field in governance.yaml ownership blocks. Prefer lowercase kebab-case (e.g. 'open-meteo', 'trentino-mobilita'); underscores are permitted because governance files in use already carry them (e.g. 'overture_maps') and the id must match the ownership name exactly.

type.description: Schema.org organization type CURIE. Emitted as the JSON-LD @type alongside foaf:Organization in DCAT-AP responses.

name.description: Human-readable display name used as foaf:name in DCAT-AP output.

role.description: The party's role with respect to the data, e.g. 'publisher', 'controller', 'processor'. Distinct from organization.role, which is the Keycloak organization role. Declared but not yet consumed by any tooling — left unconstrained until the vocabulary is settled.

did.description: did:web: URI for organizations operating a dataspace connector. Takes priority over url as the canonical @id once set.

url.description: Canonical homepage URI used as foaf:homepage in DCAT-AP output.

organization.description: Keycloak organization provisioning block. When present with create: true, celine-policies keycloak sync-orgs will provision a Keycloak organization for this owner.

create.description: When true, this owner is provisioned as a Keycloak organization by sync-orgs. Defaults to false (skipped).

role.description: Keycloak organization role. Emitted as attributes.type on the KC organization. Common values: 'rec' (Renewable Energy Community), 'dso' (Distribution System Operator), 'org' (generic organization).

attributes.description: Free-form key/value attributes set on the Keycloak organization alongside the role.

aliases.description: Alternative lookup keys that resolve to this owner. Used to map generic placeholder labels in open-source governance.yaml files (e.g. 'rec') to the real deployment-specific owner. Each alias must be unique across the registry.
